craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Stillness-gone-shown; god-at-play; Lord-doubled. Rejected: (a) play→dance → killed: play keeps līlā. Read aloud: THAT, TO-still-NESS-gone … SU-preme-LORD.

lines: That, to stillness gone, shown by being-forms —
own self, great Lord, god at play, supreme Lord.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad eva śyānatāṃ yātaṃ bhāvarūpair vibhāvyate | svātmā maheśvaro devaḥ krīḍate parameśvaraḥ

reads_against.argmap: What plays in quiescence? → Quiescence shown; self plays supreme.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion
